changes.what: LANGS = frozen [ru, kk, en]; LISTS = frozen { Г, Б, В, Ц, С }, each frozen { ru, kk, en } of frozen arrays, exactly the forms of the block as it writes them (118; «KZT» in upper case, compared without letter case); lintText(text, lang, lists = all six names) → Array<{ list, form }>: the words are the runs of [\p{L}\p{N}] of the text, lowered by toLocaleLowerCase("ru") and compared whole with the lowered forms of the lists of `lang` only; П is the number 100 taken whole (no decimal digit before it, nor a digit with «.» or «,»; no digit, «.digit» or «,digit» after it), then nothing, a space, U+00A0 or U+202F, then «%» or one of процент, процента, процентов, пайыз, percent as a whole word, in any letter case and every language; ₸ anywhere is a finding of Ц; a text that is not a string → TypeError, a language that is not ru, kk or en → RangeError, `lists` not an array → TypeError, a name that is not one of Г, Б, В, П, Ц, С → RangeError; "" → []. The findings stand in the order in which they first occur in the text, each pair of a list and a form once; the form is the list's own (as written in the list), for П the text matched, for ₸ the sign. The module is the one file of app/ outside app/test that holds the forms (FW-8's grep names only it).

Item 4: (a) lintTextsModule imports shared/i18n/texts.js by its file URL with ?sha256=<hash of its bytes> and lints every value of every key in each language of the module's LANGS — the lists, the word ban and the phrases; (b) lintPage reads each .html file: comments and <script> elements removed, every other tag replaced by a space, the numeric and thirteen named character references read, the text and the values of alt, title, aria-label and content linted with the ru lists; (c) lintIntake reads ../content/sai-intake.json beside the folder: a string under a key ru, kk or en in that language, every other string with the ru lists, both with the word ban and the phrases; a missing, unreadable or non-JSON intake, a missing, unreadable or non-importable texts module, a LANGS or TEXTS of another shape, an entry that is not an object and a value that is not a string are findings. Item 5: the output lines `check-public: <file>: <item>`, for the lint `<file>: <place>: <lang>: list <name> «<form>»` (places `key <key>`, `text`, `attribute <name>`, the intake path such as questions[0].options[0].label), identical lines once; else `check-public: app/public is clean`, exit 0. checkPublic(dir) became async (the import), its one caller is the CLI of the file (`await`); checkText(rel, text) keeps its signature; the served files are walked in name order; a folder or a file that cannot be read is a finding, not a stack.
